Critical cloud boundary flaw exploited by threat actors

Security agencies warned that threat actors are exploiting a cloud control-plane weakness to move between administrative systems and sensitive tenant data in exposed enterprise environments.

The advisory urges defenders to patch affected services, review administrative access paths, and validate logging coverage for suspicious authentication and configuration changes.

Organisations using managed cloud connectors should treat the issue as a trust-boundary problem because compromise can affect downstream monitoring, deployment, and incident response workflows.
